verdict.rationale: Codegen can auto-generate setup commands, analyze sandbox logs for errors, detect/apply repo rule files, and fix bugs/write tests via agent runs, which overlaps with making a repo 'agent-ready', but there is no documented concept of scored 'agent-readiness criteria' or a gate that automatically remediates failing readiness checks end-to-end. missing for 10: an explicit agent-readiness scoring/criteria system, evidence of automatic detection-and-fix loop tied to such criteria, and independent confirmation it works in practice.
